# Dknowledge

> Drayker's distributed memory and operational ontology across personal, project, local and global scales. This repository is the public surface for current shared orientation, papers, architecture, decisions and evidence connected to provenance.

## Read in this order

- [Current orientation](https://dknowledge.drayker.org/CURRENT.html): the current reading boundary and status.
- [Direction](https://dknowledge.drayker.org/roadmap/DIRECTION.html): current direction without treating historical dates as commitments.
- [Papers](https://dknowledge.drayker.org/papers/): the public paper collection.
- [Historical roadmap](https://dknowledge.drayker.org/roadmap/global-main-roadmap.html): preserved context, not a current delivery promise.
- [Public repository](https://github.com/draykerdk/dknowledge): primary source and change history.

## Interpretation rules

- Current guidance, active research, proposals and historical material have different status.
- A documented architecture is not proof that a service is deployed.
- Every factual claim should remain traceable to its public source.
- Drayker is the system; Dk is its intelligence; Dk Network is its network.
- Personal context remains personal; the public repository is a shared junction, not one store that absorbs every member's memory.
- Auditability does not mean total exposure: public, personal, project-restricted and security-sensitive information may have different permissions and authorized Dk contexts.
- Dk can synthesize relations held in Dknowledge; systemic safeguards — constitutional constraints, security, permissions, integrity, reserves and risk — bound what can be executed; consequential authority remains accountable to the member institutions defined for the context.
- Decisions do not end the loop: effects, refusals and consequences return through members' personal Dks as new evidence, without a universal individual veto; a decision can be maintained, adapted, excepted, suspended or reversed.
- Security conditions normal decisions, not only attacks. Legitimate criticism is not infiltration; internal error is not sabotage; extraordinary measures leave memory for later review.
- The current ecosystem papers define Distributed Support, Dktron, the economy of capacity and Will to Potential in relation to the whole system.

## Crawling and citation

Public pages may be indexed and quoted with attribution. Prefer the most specific canonical page and link back to its source. The sitemap is at https://dknowledge.drayker.org/sitemap.xml.
